instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Insurance brokerage firm advising corporate clients on risk management programs spanning property, casualty, cyber, D&O, and employee benefits. Team of 35 brokers managing €60M in placed premiums. Seeking to implement a risk analytics platform for client exposure modeling and benchmarking. Enterprise-scale organization with complex multi-layer governance, dedicated innovation/R&D departments, and formal stage-gate project approval processes. We have substantial resources but also significant organizational inertia — aligning stakeholders across divisions takes deliberate effort and senior executive sponsorship.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is embedded in our operating rhythm. We run quarterly hackathons, maintain a formal patent portfolio, and have a rotating 'innovation fellow' program where high-potential employees spend 6 months dedicated to exploratory projects. Our last hackathon produced a prototype for automated quality inspection using computer vision that is now in production, reducing defect escape rate by 35%.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.teamSize: Our digital and innovation organization includes 80+ professionals across centers of excellence for AI/ML, cloud engineering, UX design, and agile delivery. We run an internal incubator program that has graduated 6 new digital products to market in the past 2 years, alongside a corporate venture capital arm that makes strategic minority investments in relevant startups.

input.changes_since_last: Completed 6 strategic partnerships. Revenue growth 15% YoY. Exploring AI/ML capabilities.

opportunities.title: Establish Non-Insurance Vertical Risk Advisory Service (AI-Driven)
opportunities.rationale: Nexus is highly exposed due to concentrated client revenue. The core capability—advanced risk modeling using AI/ML—is transferable beyond traditional insurance products. This initiative aims to transform the firm from a product seller into a holistic operational risk consultant for adjacent industries.

first_actions: Form a dedicated task force comprising R&D, Strategy, and Business Development, reporting directly to the C-suite (senior sponsorship).
Conduct rapid market assessments on 3 non-insurance sectors (e.g., logistics, healthcare operations) to identify critical operational risk gaps.
Develop a minimum viable product (MVP) focused solely on benchmarking AI/ML models against sector-specific loss data.
resources_needed: Initial seed funding for external market research and pilot clients
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure three paying pilots in non-insurance sectors within 12 months.
milestones: Completion of initial sector screening report (Q3).
MVP prototype demonstration to first potential client group (Q4).

opportunities.title: Standardize and Scale Internal Innovation Incubator Model
opportunities.rationale: The company has successfully proven its ability to generate digital products (CV prototype, 6 graduated products). This opportunity formalizes the successful incubation process into a standardized playbook that can be applied systematically across product lines and geographical regions.

first_actions: Document the full lifecycle of the 'innovation fellow' program, identifying key bottlenecks in stage-gate approval processes.
Create tiered funding/resource allocation criteria based on pilot success metrics (e.g., revenue potential vs. complexity).
Pilot the scaled process within two distinct business units to ensure cross-functional applicability.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average time from idea conception to measurable pilot launch by 20%.
milestones: Successful rollout and utilization across two major BUs within one fiscal quarter.

next_steps.action: Mandate a cross-functional Steering Committee (including representatives from the top 3 client segments) to formally allocate resources and define shared KPIs for the diversification initiatives.

Conduct a formal 'opportunity cost analysis' quantifying the financial risk associated with maintaining high client concentration (the top 3 clients). This informs the necessary scope of diversification funding.

Launch a specialized 'Strategic Talent Sprint' to rapidly cross-train key brokers and technical staff in the core methodologies of non-insurance risk advisory (e.g., supply chain resilience modeling).

key_weaknesses: High dependence on a concentrated customer base (55% revenue from top 3 clients) presents an existential threat.
Despite formal processes, significant organizational inertia and difficulty aligning stakeholders across divisions remains a systemic drag.
The internal focus tends to be reactive (improving current products) rather than proactively defining disruptive business models outside the core insurance silo.

improvements: Successfully institutionalized innovation by moving successful prototypes (e.g., CV inspection tool) into production, demonstrating operational capability.
Significantly matured internal talent and digital infrastructure (80+ professionals, VC arm, incubator), providing high execution capacity.
Increased revenue growth (15% YoY implied) validates market acceptance of current strategic focus.
persistent_gaps: Strategic alignment required to fully pivot from product-based sales to service/consulting model needed for diversification.
Lack of standardized process linking innovative concepts directly to new revenue streams, risking high sunk cost in exploration.
Mitigation strategies for the acute client concentration risk are still theoretical.
achieved_milestones: Operational proof-of-concept for advanced AI/ML risk modeling in production environments.
Formalization of the corporate venture capital arm's role from investment to active operational strategy input.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has drastically improved its operational maturity and execution capability by professionalizing internal innovation (hackathons, incubator) and successfully launching advanced digital products into the market, shifting from potential to proven delivery.
